description: Change one notification setting for the signed-in person: a switch (key from notification_prefs_get, channel push or email, on), quiet hours (HH:MM start and end, IANA zone), or mute a workspace for push. Answers the whole settings view.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

quiet.description: Quiet hours in the person's own time zone (HH:MM, IANA zone)

name: notification_prefs_set
title: Change a notification setting
